description: Capability for the main window. Custom PTY commands (spawn_pty, write_pty, resize_pty, close_pty, list_panes, attach_pty, stash_handoff, take_handoff) are app-local and permitted by default; only the minimal core surface is granted here (CLAUDE.md §15). `core:window:allow-close` lets the frontend close the window when the last pane's shell exits; `core:webview:allow-create-webview-window` lets it pop a pane out into a detached window.
